scope: Two native Bun declarations test fail-closed value edits when a workbook has a calculation-chain relationship. They use a constructed nonstandard chain based on the sealed cross-sheet-cache.xlsx input. This refusal differs from the successful owned-chain removal required by @id-xlsx-owned-calculation-chain-invalidation; it does not select that case.

mappings.nativeId: bun:tests/unit/xlsx-owned-chain-refusal.test.ts:owned nonstandard chain value edit refuses before stale metadata can survive

The canonical owned-chain case instead requires a successful edit, removal of the chain/relationship/override, selective cache invalidation and saved readback; none is executed by this refusal.

mappings.nativeId: bun:tests/unit/xlsx-owned-chain-refusal.test.ts:owned chain workflow refusal preserves source and an existing destination
